trailhead.label: Altfasstal car park (paid), the board’s start

cautions: Forest road shared with bikes and occasional service traffic: keep your dog close.
Cows graze in the upper valley in summer: keep your dog on a lead.
Kneipp pools along the way: keep your dog out of them.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
